# Josh Renema

> Josh is a full stack developer with a soft spot for design, based in Vancouver. This is his portfolio, a single page showing selected work and ways to get in touch.

Josh is open to new projects that mix solid code with good design. He works at Territorial, building software for real people with real problems.

## Projects

- [Sors Finance](https://github.com/jos-ren/Sors-Finance): Personal finance app with a dashboard for monthly spending, net worth and trends. Also published as a Docker image.
- [Flag Guessr](https://jos-ren.github.io/flag-guessr/): Flag quiz game with world and continent modes. Source: https://github.com/jos-ren/flag-guessr
- [Room Planner](https://alexrussell.dev/room-planner/?mode=floor): Floor plan editor for laying out rooms and furniture. Source: https://github.com/aj3x/room-planner
- Muvi: Mobile app for tracking movies and shows. Not released yet.
